title: Pre-test suite fix: resolve 2 named pre-existing test failures
full_pretest_note: The 2 named tests are fixed. 3 other pre-existing failures remain that were not visible in exp2295 (likely masked by artifact presence and xdist scheduling): test_experiment_1692_potts_v2_artifact (missing results artifact file), test_experiment_390_gpu_preflight (xdist GPU error, passes in isolation), test_experiment_294_gpu_baseline_apple (xdist ERROR, passes in isolation). None are caused by this exp's changes.
fix_rationale_1: Root cause: _module_version() in python/carnot/hardware/thrml_compatibility_audit.py fell back to importlib.metadata.version('thrml') when the injected module had no __version__ attribute. Since thrml 0.1.3 is installed in the venv, metadata lookup returned '0.1.3' instead of 'unknown'. The test injects a SimpleNamespace() as the module (no __version__) and asserts version == 'unknown'. Fix: removed the importlib.metadata fallback. The module's own __version__ is now the sole source; absent that, 'unknown' is returned. This is correct semantics: a custom importer may return an object that is NOT the installed thrml package, so metadata for 'thrml' would be misleading. Source changed: python/carnot/hardware/thrml_compatibility_audit.py::_module_version.
fix_rationale_2: Root cause: check_issue_14_soskan_auroc() in scripts/experiment_1182_paper_v5_medium_low_issues_11_18.py scans ±220-char windows around every occurrence of '0.9545' in main.tex and requires that any window containing 'SOS' also contains a sample size ('n=6{,}548', '6{,}548-pair', or 'n=50'). The paper had an occurrence at line 1047 ('On the FoVer training corpus, SOSKANEnergyV3 achieves $\mathrm{AUROC}=0.9545$ (exp1072).') where the sample size n=6{,}548 fell outside the 440-char window. Fix: added '(n=6{,}548)' to that sentence in docs/arxiv-paper/main.tex, making the corpus size explicit at the point of citation. This is the correct fix per paper integrity discipline (paper should state sample size when citing AUROC values). Source changed: docs/arxiv-paper/main.tex line 1047.
